entities.summary: Mel Rojas Jr. is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Guerreros de Oaxaca of the Mexican League. He has previously played in the KBO League for the KT Wiz and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
